entities.name: SCG Failure Information Procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by UE to inform E-UTRAN or NR MN about an SCG failure experienced by the UE, including SCG radio link failure, SCG reconfiguration with sync failure, SCG configuration failure for RRC message on SRB3, SCG integrity check failure, and consistent uplink LBT failures on PSCell.

entities.name: RRC reconfiguration
entities.description: RRC message sent from network to UE to reconfigure radio parameters.

entities.name: SCGFailureInformation
entities.description: RRC message sent from UE to network to report SCG failure information.

entities.name: SCG radio link failure
entities.description: Condition where SCG radio link fails.

entities.name: Failure of SCG reconfiguration with sync
entities.description: Condition where SCG reconfiguration with synchronization fails.

entities.name: SCG configuration failure for RRC message on SRB3
entities.description: Condition where SCG configuration fails for RRC message transmission on SRB3.

entities.name: SCG integrity check failure
entities.description: Condition where SCG integrity check fails.

entities.name: Consistent uplink LBT failures on PSCell
entities.description: Condition where consistent uplink listen-before-talk failures occur on PSCell for shared spectrum channel access.

relations.description: SCG Failure Information Procedure includes sending SCGFailureInformation message.
SCGFailureInformation message is triggered by SCG radio link failure condition.
SCGFailureInformation message is triggered by SCG reconfiguration with sync failure condition.
SCGFailureInformation message is triggered by SCG configuration failure for RRC message on SRB3 condition.
SCGFailureInformation message is triggered by SCG integrity check failure condition.
SCGFailureInformation message is triggered by consistent uplink LBT failures on PSCell condition.
